subject.title: Bug: write tool and exec heredocs insert literal \n instead of newlines in string content

question: Should maintainers repair and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95982 as the fix for this issue, coordinate it with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96748 first, or close/narrow one of the parser PRs before continuing?
rationale: The issue is a real bug, but the remaining fix changes a shared parser heuristic with Windows-path compatibility constraints and an already-open PR has concrete review blockers plus a real-behavior proof gap.

options.title: Coordinate the parser PRs first
options.body: Review the code-context and escaped-backslash heuristic changes together, then land the narrow parser rule with compatibility tests and real tool-run proof.

options.title: Repair only the code-context PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96748 separate and ask the author of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95982 to address the current blockers and proof gap.

options.title: Pause for a new owner patch
options.body: Close or hold the existing PRs if maintainers want a single owner-authored parser rewrite instead of contributor branches.

recommendation.title: Coordinate the parser PRs first
recommendation.body: Review the code-context and escaped-backslash heuristic changes together, then land the narrow parser rule with compatibility tests and real tool-run proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the clearest history on the Windows-path heuristic and merged PR that introduced the current compatibility contract.
